retrievalProfile.description: A high-key, soft-focus portrait of a subject in white clothing against a white background, emphasizing a pensive or melancholic mood through a hunched, geometric pose.
triggerTerms: white on white soft focus photography
excludeWhen: the subject must be looking at the camera

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-key photograph of a man with dark hair, dressed in a white button-down shirt and white trousers. He is crouched with his head bowed and hands near his temples, creating a triangular composition. The lighting is extremely soft and diffused, causing the white clothing to nearly merge with the white background, leaving only the subject's face and hair as points of contrast.
coreVisualRelationships: soft focus vs sharp hair texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the majority of the frame, positioned slightly off-center to the right, with the head tilted downward toward the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark hair provide the primary visual anchor against the white field.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the curve of the subject's back down to the hands, then up to the face and hair.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space on the left and top edges, reinforcing the high-key aesthetic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation, extremely high value (brightness) with minimal tonal range.
paletteRestrictions: limited to whites, creams, and natural skin/hair tones

composition.relationshipToImage: horizontal band across the subject's knees

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family with color shifts to distinguish name from title.

candidateDirections.reason: Clean, neutral, and supports wide tracking well.
Geometric circles match the airy, modern feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, soft-focus portrait of a man in white clothing against a white background, crouched in a pensive pose with head down.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add lowercase geometric sans-serif text in the lower third, using wide tracking and a muted color palette.

verificationChecks: Is the exposure high-key with minimal shadows?
Is the text lowercase and widely tracked?
Does the subject's clothing blend into the background?

mustRedesign: exact facial likeness of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the white clothing.
Verify the pose conveys introspection rather than distress.
Check that the hair texture remains visible despite the soft focus.
Confirm the high-key exposure hasn't blown out all facial detail.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key soft-focus portrait + white-on-white environment + pensive crouched pose + lowercase geometric sans-serif typography.
